items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Benny talks about it. [INTERVIEWEE] That could have been... [INTERVIEWER] Not Benny? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: I’m not sure about that. They may have been. I can’t put my finger on when exactly that was, the Howard Swing Masters. What do you mean, the house band at the Howard?
No. There was a band at Howard University called the Swing Masters, not officially a part of the university, but Bill Hughes talks about it. Benny talks about it.
That could have been, because Bill Hughes was in the marching band with us too. So that’s why . . .
